s.n: Wolfhouse giant pretzels with mustard butter
s.note: Jan and Todd's trip to Oktoberfest in Munich
s.how: Heat the oven to 220C. Divide 1kg pizza dough into 4 and roll into 80cm ropes. Twist into pretzel shapes. Simmer 3L water with 90g bicarb soda and dip each pretzel for 30 seconds. Lay on lined trays, brush with egg, scatter with rock salt and bake 15 to 18 minutes until deep brown. Beat 125g soft butter with 2 tbsp wholegrain mustard and 1 tsp honey. Serve with sliced radishes tossed in vinegar and salt.

Mash 250g ripe camembert with a fork until mostly smooth. Beat in 60g soft butter, 100g cream cheese, 2 tsp sweet paprika, half a tsp caraway seeds, half a very finely diced red onion and 2 tbsp lager. Season with salt and pepper and chill 30 minutes. Spread on 12 slices of dark rye and top with thin red onion rings, chives and a dusting of paprika.

m.note: Great Gam Gam and the Wolfhouse family secret
m.how: Boil 1kg waxy potatoes 20 minutes and slice. Fry 100g diced bacon, add 3 tbsp white wine vinegar, 1 tbsp mustard, 100ml stock and 2 tbsp oil and toss through the warm potatoes with chives. Pound 4 pork steaks to 5mm. Coat in flour, 2 beaten eggs and 150g breadcrumbs. Fry in 50g butter and 4 tbsp oil for 3 minutes a side, shaking the pan so the crumb puffs. Serve with lemon and cranberry jam.

w.how: Toss 4 sliced apples with 60g sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and 60g sultanas. Roll in 2 sheets puff pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 30 minutes. Dust with icing sugar and serve with cream.

d.note: Das Boot, the glass boot of the final round
d.how: Make lemon syrup by simmering 100g sugar, 100ml water and the zest of 2 lemons for 3 minutes, then add the juice of 3 lemons and chill. Mix the syrup with 600ml cold soda water. Pour 250ml cold German lager into each of 4 steins and top with 200ml of the lemon soda. Add a lemon wheel. For non-drinkers, serve the lemon soda on its own over ice.
